## An example: 

``` {r results=FALSE}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
n <- 150
treatment <- c(rep("no_contra", n), rep("contra", n))
results <- c(rnorm(n, 9, 1), rnorm(n, 11, 1))
df <- tibble(treatment = treatment, value = results)
lin_model <- glm(value ~ as_factor(treatment), data = df)
res <- tidy(lin_model)
```

``` {r results=TRUE}
ggplot(data = df, mapping = aes(x = treatment, y = value, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.background = element_rect(color = "black")) +
    labs(title = "A random test")

print(res)
```
